## Refreshed end-to-end percentile analysis after direct close instrumentation

Reproduction
- Command: `python scripts/rebar_duration_probe.py summary --tracker .tickets-tracker --since 2026-08-07T12:34:40Z --provider-prefix bedrock: --current-since 2026-08-22T00:00:00Z`.
- Parsed 666 rollout logs and matched terminal command duration to tracker sidecars.
- Clean rows exclude force, status/check/help, interrupted or incomplete processes, unmatched events, no-LLM rows, and records whose actual `ran_model` does not begin `bedrock:`. PASS and completed non-PASS outcomes remain.
- Percentiles are Hyndman-Fan type 7.

Plan review
- Full clean cohort n=123, window 2026-08-11T04:32:27.767Z through 2026-08-27T03:20:33.257Z: p50=518.464s (8.64m), p90=875.035s (14.58m), p99=2987.802s (49.80m). Padded p50-to-p90 range=622.157-1050.042s (10.37-17.50m).
- Current regime from 2026-08-22, n=65: p50=663.300s (11.06m), p90=993.914s (16.57m), p99=4606.863s (76.78m). Padded range=795.960-1192.697s (13.27-19.88m). Rounded guidance remains approximately 15-20 minutes.

Gated close
- Full clean cohort n=55, window 2026-08-11T07:24:34.780Z through 2026-08-27T03:25:42.038Z: p50=495.938s (8.27m), p90=1702.655s (28.38m), p99=3553.331s (59.22m). Padded range=595.126-2043.186s (9.92-34.05m).
- Mixed current regime n=27: p50=574.695s (9.58m), p90=2478.951s (41.32m), p99=3642.008s (60.70m), padded=689.634-2974.741s (11.49-49.58m). This is not a clean causal current-performance cohort: 22 rows predate direct phase instrumentation and retain an unexplained legacy residual; only five rows have the complete direct partition.
- Directly instrumented closes n=5, 2026-08-25 through 2026-08-27: end-to-end p50=448.512s (7.48m), p90=530.602s (8.84m), p99=570.286s (9.50m). Padded range=538.214-636.723s (8.97-10.61m), provisionally about 9-11 minutes. The sample is small and the pinned-ticket-view rollout is default-off, so this is not evidence of pinned-mode performance.

Direct close attribution
- Pre-verifier total, n=5: p50/p90/p99=19.401/21.014/21.393s. Its leaves are structural scan 3.805/5.949/6.300s, material policy 5.952/8.707/9.964s, descendant scope 4.839/4.882/4.895s, and landing check 2.408/2.929/3.067s. Git-history read, alias-index build, reference resolution, and diff validation are all separately timed and collectively small.
- Verifier call, n=5: 416.113/486.266/517.749s. Handle resolution is 171.889/230.668/234.484s, almost entirely ticket snapshot construction at 171.436/230.337/234.187s. Here ticket snapshot means constructing the stable read-only ticket view used by the verifier, not the outer ticket object fetch.
- Dispatch/workflow total, n=5: 212.220/267.599/267.621s. Leaf workflow timing is available for the newest n=2 only: closure checks plus context/prefetch 7.051/8.364/8.659s; completion agent including model/tools/recovery 137.167/188.104/199.565s; verdict reconciliation 0.007/0.008/0.008s; validation/routing/recording residual 0.082/0.085/0.086s; no-LLM and unclassified steps 0s.
- `unattributed_verifier` is zero for all five, and `unattributed_workflow` is zero for both rows with leaf instrumentation. The earlier claim that pre-workflow scanning dominates current closes is therefore superseded for directly instrumented runs. Current cost is split mainly between stable ticket-view construction and the completion-agent workflow.

Interpretation pending confirmation
- Proposed plan-review wording: about 15-20 minutes, based on current-regime p50 and p90 plus 20 percent.
- Proposed gated-close wording: provisionally about 9-11 minutes, based on the directly instrumented n=5 p50 and p90 plus 20 percent, with an explicit warning that older mixed cohorts contain real 40-60 minute tails and the direct sample is still small.
- No guidance or repository documentation was changed.
